manifest.name: ListenBrainz
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Scrobble what you play to ListenBrainz, and get recommendations and mixes from your listening history.
manifest.requirement: Needs your ListenBrainz username, and your user token to save listens.

userToken.label: User token
userToken.description: Required for submitting listens and accessing private data

account.usage: your recommendations, similar listeners and history come from this account
account.advancedHint: Optional: add your user token to save listens and see private data. It’s on your ListenBrainz settings page.
